name: Seamdeck
description: A tiny game console for your space. The frame is the whole device: a handheld on narrow screens, a TV + controller on wide ones. Anyone who can open it — members and link visitors alike — opens lobbies of little Phosphor-icon games (shot put, regatta, hot slice), joins other people's, takes turns or races in realtime, and chases the space's high-score board. Controls: D-pad via arrows/WASD, O = primary, I = secondary/back. Lobbies live in the frame's worker while it runs; the high scores are the space's seamdeck_scores table, one board per space that every Seamdeck in it shares. It's also a template — each game is a self-contained two-file cartridge, and the console gives every cartridge lobbies, turn rotation, realtime racing, spectators, results, and high scores for free, so forking it into your own console is mostly writing games.
